questions.stem: How is plant cell differentiation different from animal cell differentiation?

options.text: Plant cells can differentiate throughout the plant's life; most animal cells can only differentiate during early development
Plant cells cannot differentiate at all
Animal cells can differentiate at any age but plant cells cannot
There is no difference between plant and animal differentiation

questions.explanation: Plants retain meristem tissue that can differentiate throughout their entire life, allowing continuous growth and the ability to regrow lost parts. In animals, most cell differentiation occurs only during early embryonic development.
